targets.expr: topk(10, 100 * sum by(namespace,pod,container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!="",container!="POD",namespace=~"$namespace"}) / on(namespace,pod,container) group_left max by(namespace,pod,container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="memory"}))

panels.title: Top 10 Containers - Memory Usage vs Limits

panels.description: Containers missing from the Top 10 memory panel because they have no limit to compare against.

targets.expr: count(count by(namespace,pod,container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!="",container!="POD"}) unless on(namespace,pod,container) kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="memory"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: No Memory Limit

panels.description: Containers missing from the Top 10 CPU panel because they have no limit to compare against.

targets.expr: count(count by(namespace,pod,container) (container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container!="",container!="POD"}) unless on(namespace,pod,container) kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="cpu"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: No CPU Limit

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by(namespace,pod,container) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container!="",container!="POD",namespace=~"$namespace"}[5m])) / on(namespace,pod,container) group_left max by(namespace,pod,container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="cpu"}))

panels.title: Top 10 Containers - CPU Usage vs Limits

targets.expr: topk(10, 100 * pve_cpu_usage_ratio{id=~"qemu.*|lxc.*"} * on(id) group_left(name) max by(id,name) (pve_guest_info))
